Some messages, he decided, arrive exactly when they are meant to, even if the world insists they are too late.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉入最深的寂静。路灯把橘黄色的光铺在空旷的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，溅起细碎的光斑。清洁工的扫帚有节奏地划过人行道，簌簌声在楼宇之间回荡。远处早点铺的灯亮了，蒸笼里白雾升腾，揉面的声响隐约可闻。天际线还压着深蓝，只有东方透出一丝将明未明的灰。这座城市像一个浅眠的人，翻了个身，即将醒来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a task solves itself by breaking into a smaller version of the same task — like looking up a word in the dictionary and the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive task needs a stopping point (called the base case) so you don't keep going forever — eventually the definition uses words you already know.\n• Imagine you're in a line and you ask the person behind you \"how many people are behind me?\" — they ask the person behind them the same question, and so on, until the last person says \"zero,\" and the answers get passed back up to you."}
